full_description: In the KitchenS scene (no sink or microwave), raw food starts on a chopping board. Put the food into the pan on the stove, turn the stove knob up to 180 degrees to cook to the food's ideal doneness (meat medium, chicken dark-yellow, sausage dark-red), then turn the knob back to zero. Success is adequate doneness after the stove is off; leave the food in the pan.
